title: API Receipt Extension
description: Extends receipt.base.schema.json. Module-specific fields for the API module.

api_version.description: API version being acted on. e.g. v2, 2024-01-15, 3.

versioning_scheme.description: Versioning scheme in use for this API.

breaking_changes.description: Count of BREAKING changes in this API operation.

deprecations_added.description: Count of items entering Stage 1 deprecation this session.

deprecations_sunset.description: Count of items reaching Stage 3 (removed) this session.

backward_compatible.description: True if all five contract enforcement checks pass.

contract_path.description: Path to API contract artifact. e.g. .wabblespec/api/contract-<timestamp>.json
